gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.

gaps.sentence: The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (APPOINT) at the election result.
